context.prd-excerpt:
Project: Link Shelf (slug link-shelf). Project type: greenfield. Project path: C:/Users/Lee/AppData/Local/Temp/oq7-qn0r6zml/poor/app
Later layers write into three subpackages of `app`, and each of those tasks is capped at three files. Creating the package markers here keeps a later task from having to spend one of its three files on a __init__.py.
Which later tasks write where, so the three subpackages are justified rather than guessed: app/models/ - L4-002 writes app/models/link.py (the Link model); L4-003 writes app/models/tag.py and app/models/link_tag.py app/api/ - L3-002 creates app/api/links.py (the APIRouter); L3-003, L3-004 and L3-006 add handlers to that same file app/schemas/ - L3-001 writes app/schemas/link.py (LinkCreate, LinkRead); L3-005 writes app/schemas/tag.py (TagAttach, LinkWithTags)
No other subpackage is created. In particular there is no app/services/ and no app/core/: the PRD has three endpoints and no service layer was inferred, and an empty package that nothing imports is dead weight.
context.tech-stack: Python 3.11, FastAPI 0.110+, SQLAlchemy 2.x, SQLite (file-backed, no server process), pytest 8.x. Backend only.
